rows.notes: Automated benchmark via agent. Model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Infatoshi NVFP4-FP8 (mixed-precision: NVFP4 MoE experts + FP8 attention), Docker vllm/vllm-openai:nightly, MTP spec decode.
2x RTX 3090 NVLink, Ornstein 3.6-35B-A3B MoE (3B active params), all layers on GPU, flash attention. llama-bench pp512 tg128.

hipfire @ 0.1.8-alpha+f16eceb (master post-perf-recovery, PR #47)
prompt: "Explain the theory of general relativity in simple terms."
runs: 3 (median reported)
decode mode: AR (autoregressive, no spec-decode)
kv_cache: asym3 (3-bit rotated K + Q8 V; 5.5x vs fp32)
prompt_normalize: true (default since 2026-04-26)
pp128: 328.1 tok/s
pp512: 324.6 tok/s
pp1024: 323.1 tok/s
pp2048: 318.9 tok/s
vram_loaded: 22660 MB
Quantized in-house: hipfire-quantize MQ4 (FWHT-rotated 4-bit, group=256)
Automated benchmark via LM Studio local API. 2 warm-up runs; median of 3 measured greedy chat completions with max_tokens=256.

Quality-gated Qwen3.6 35B Quark W8A8 INT8 run on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70. Metric is p512/n512 streaming /v1/completions, temperature 0, four repeats after warmup. tokSOut is corrected steady-state output throughput after first streamed text chunk; e2e output mean was 98.16 tok/s. Frontdoor quality rerun8 passed exact canaries, JSON schema/semantics, copy phrase, 8K long-context needle, repeat stability, and baseline hash parity. Peak VRAM was not submitted because this run used --skip-vram.

Constrained simple-site quality benchmark, not unconstrained website generation. MiniMax M2.7 AutoRound INT4 on 4x Arc Pro B70, TP4, forced XPU graph with no-op XPU comm capture, scaffolded assistant prefill, tight structured HTML suffix, prefix caching. One validated warmup excluded from measured service throughput. Rerun result: 30/30 accepted, 0 rejects, 100% first-pass, 94.46 effective measured output tok/s; companion run: 94.53 tok/s. Approx prompt/input throughput derived from vLLM progress and prompt length; strict harness validated complete HTML/body, exact list items, required copy, no control chars, no malformed angle markup.

Regex2 constrained simple-HTML fast lane. Repeat30 quality-gated run: 30/30 accepted, 0 rejects, 100% first-attempt pass, 1471 accepted output tokens, 15.582 s accepted decode, 94.406 effective accepted output tok/s, 94.692 post-first tok/s. Structured JSON cross-check also passed 9/9 with 0 rejects at 87.956 tok/s and stable parsed JSON hashes. Not an unconstrained free-form website benchmark; this records a validated structured-output lane.

Warm steady-state MiniMax M2.7 AutoRound TP4 on 4x Arc Pro B70. One persistent vLLM engine; 2 p512/n1536 warmup requests discarded; 4 measured greedy repeats. Strict quality passed first on the same fresh cache root: raw145 n64/n256 exact hashes, semantic suite, 8-run arithmetic repeat, and extended sixpack. Older 20260519 compile cache was rejected after raw145 n256 hash drift, so this result uses the quality-clean 20260521 cache root. No speculative decoding, expert dropping, sampling change, or power-limit increase.

Repeatability/control run after reverting a negative prefill64 MoE experiment. Strict quality passed raw145 n64/n256 exact hashes, semantic suite, arithmetic repeat n64/r8, and extended sixpack n64/r2. Restores promoted decode-only llm-scaler INT4 MoE gate and reproduces the prior ~89 tok/s result.

MiniMax M2.7 AutoRound W4A16 on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70 via vLLM/XPU TP4. Strict quality passed before benchmarking: raw145 exact token hashes at n64/n256, semantic suite, 16-run arithmetic repeat, and extended sixpack. New strict high: output tok/s repeats 88.927239, 89.396677, 89.527321, 89.405544; mean 89.314195 output tok/s and 119.085594 total tok/s. Candidate adds VLLM_MINIMAX_MOE_FULL_FORWARD_CUSTOM_OP=1 on top of the prior MoE output-allreduce-inside-custom-op path, wrapping the MiniMax MoE decode-sized router-linear plus fused MoE call in a guarded custom-op boundary. No speculative decoding, no expert dropping, no router approximation, no quant-quality change, no power-limit change.

MiniMax M2.7 AutoRound W4A16 on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70 via vLLM/XPU TP4. Strict quality passed before benchmarking: raw145 exact token hashes at n64/n256, semantic suite, 16-run arithmetic repeat, and extended sixpack. New clean high: output tok/s repeats 88.422654, 89.595083, 88.524703, 89.169339; mean 88.927945 output tok/s and 118.570593 total tok/s. Candidate moves the final MoE output allreduce inside the MoE custom-op boundary with VLLM_MINIMAX_MOE_OUTPUT_ALLREDUCE_INSIDE_CUSTOM_OP=1, guarded to no shared experts/no routed transform/no sequence parallel; final outer allreduce is skipped under the same static guard. No speculative decoding, no expert dropping, no router approximation, no quant-quality change, no power-limit change.
